note:
Header banner for /collections/pdrn.

SOURCE: banner library, pdrn-collagen-repair-cream--B-face-full-prod-right-gpt_image_01
(2048x848, 2.41:1). Every quoted line on the jar was checked at 100% and is correct:
  Skingenetix / PDRN COLLAGEN REPAIR / DEEP RENEWAL TREATMENT / PREMIUM FORMULA
No retouching of the product was needed.

CANVAS EXTENDED, not cropped — Malcolm asked for the full height to stay visible in
the header, so the frame grew leftward to 3:1 (2544x848) instead of being trimmed to
fit. scripts/extend-banner-canvas.py builds the 496px of new backdrop.

The subject TOUCHES the left edge: below y=632 the shoulder runs off frame, so flat
padding would have smeared it into a bar. The fill is stitched from two parts — the
backdrop held at its own vertical gradient, and the edge profile sheared downward as
it travels left so the shoulder sinks out of the bottom-left corner the way the real
one does. Backdrop weave is mirror-tiled from the shot; shoulder grain is scattered
rather than tiled, because mirror-tiling skin drew a visible diamond across it.
Measured seam at the join is 1.7 levels against 2.0 for ordinary neighbouring
columns — i.e. inside the image's own noise.

REVISED 2026-08-24 after review — the header must keep the theme's STANDARD height
(image_size sm, 375/400/440), the same as every other collection page; an earlier
pass used image_size "auto" to avoid cropping and made these two headers taller
than the rest of the site. A fixed-height box crops by definition, so the master is
widened to 3000px instead: at a fixed height object-fit cover scales purely by
height, and the surplus width becomes croppable margin that the template's
object-position aims at the extension rather than at the product.
